trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: The Platinum. It unlocks by itself the moment you earn the other 54 trophies — there is nothing extra to do for it. Plan for roughly 200 hours in total, most of it spent on the 100% completion checklist behind the gold trophy A Long Road. No online play, no difficulty setting and no DLC are needed.
steps: Earn the other 54 trophies.
The Platinum pops automatically once the last one lands.

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: Unmissable story trophy. It pops when you finish the opening mission, Gone Fishing, in Chapter 1 — the first mission of the game, so every player earns it within the first hour. There is no way to skip it and no special requirement.
steps: Play the opening mission Gone Fishing to its end.

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Unmissable story trophy for finishing Chapter 1. Note that chapter trophies can pop at the start of the next chapter rather than on the last cutscene, so do not worry if it lands a little late. While you are in Chapter 1, do Lucia's balcony meditation — it is the one thing in the chapter that can be missed (see Positive Mental Attitude).
steps: Finish every main mission of Chapter 1.
Before leaving Chapter 1, do Lucia's balcony meditation for Positive Mental Attitude.

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: Unmissable story trophy for finishing Chapter 2. Character switching between Jason and Lucia opens up during this chapter, which unlocks most of the partner trophies and the side activities. Keep a manual save at the start of the chapter — there is no mission replay, so a save per chapter is your only safety net.
steps: Finish every main mission of Chapter 2.
Keep a manual save from the start of the chapter.

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: Unmissable story trophy for finishing Chapter 3. Do the time-sensitive Race Against Yago in Yago's street racing strand the moment it appears (it shows an hourglass icon) — it counts toward Strangers & Freaks. This is also the chapter where the Snap Gun jewelry jobs open up for Sneakthief.
steps: Finish every main mission of Chapter 3.
Do Race Against Yago as soon as it appears — it is time-sensitive.

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide: Unmissable story trophy for finishing Chapter 4. Near the end of this chapter the optional mission That's Where The Money Is opens the bank vault robberies behind Maximum Withdrawal, so do it before the finale if you want the vaults started early. Keep a manual save from just before the final mission.
steps: Finish every main mission of Chapter 4.
Do the optional mission That's Where The Money Is to open bank vaults.
Keep an untouched manual save from before the final mission.

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide: Gold story trophy for finishing the final mission. It pops when the credits roll. Everything outside the story stays available in free-roam afterwards, so the finale is a beginning, not an end: the 100% checklist only appears after the story (Progress > Stats > 100% Completion), and all of the cleanup happens after this trophy.
steps: Finish the final mission.
After the credits, open Progress > Stats > 100% Completion to start Stage 2.

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide: Unmissable story trophy. Breakfast Run is a named main mission; play it to the end and the trophy pops. Like all mission trophies it cannot be missed, because the story must be finished to reach the Platinum anyway.
steps: Play the main mission Breakfast Run to its end.

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guide: Unmissable story trophy. The Cartel Heist is a named main mission; finish it and the trophy pops. Heist missions are story beats, so there is no extra preparation and no way to miss it.
steps: Play the main mission The Cartel Heist to its end.

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide: Unmissable story trophy. Child's Play is a named main mission; finish it and the trophy pops. It is one of the story mission trophies that fill in automatically as you play through the chapters.
steps: Play the main mission Child's Play to its end.

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.guide: Unmissable story trophy. Headliners is a named main mission; finish it and the trophy pops. No side requirement is attached to it — just the story.
steps: Play the main mission Headliners to its end.

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide: Unmissable story trophy. VCIA Takedown is a named main mission at Vice City International Airport; finish it and the trophy pops. The airport is also where Catch Me If You Can is earned later, by stealing a jet from a boarding bridge.
steps: Play the main mission VCIA Takedown to its end.

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.guide: Unmissable story trophy. Operation Savage Glory is a named main mission; finish it and the trophy pops. It is the last of the named-mission story trophies on the list.
steps: Play the main mission Operation Savage Glory to its end.

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: The hardest trophy and the bulk of the Platinum — gold for the 100% completion checklist, which appears after the story under Progress > Stats > 100% Completion. Progress made during the story already counts, and nothing on the checklist is missable. PowerPyx notes the checklist is only about 60% of true completion: it needs 300 stunts, 70 of the 80 Challenges, 200 of the 277 base-model vehicles scanned, 100 of the 255 animals studied through binoculars, all 8 bank vaults, all 39 gang operations and 15 of the 18 meditation spots. Expect around 100 hours for this stage alone.
steps: Finish the story, then open Progress > Stats > 100% Completion.
Work the checklist: 300 stunts, 70 of 80 Challenges, 200 of 277 vehicles, 100 of 255 animals.
Rob all 8 bank vaults and all 39 gang operations; meditate at 15 of 18 spots.

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Silver for 250 stunts. Stunt jumps, under-the-bridge flights, knife flights and base jumps all count, so mix them as you travel rather than grinding one type. Keep going past 250: the 100% checklist needs 300, so stopping at the trophy would only leave work for later.
steps: Do stunt jumps, under-bridge and knife flights, and base jumps as you travel.
Reach 250 for the trophy, then continue to 300 for A Long Road.

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Bronze for sampling every activity type once — 9 types in total, per the PSN progress counter. This is a sampler, not a grind: play one round of each activity (racing, fishing, arcade, bowling, the shooting range, drone races and the rest) and it pops. A good early trophy to clear while the map is still opening up.
steps: Try one of each of the 9 activity types.
Check the PSN counter after each new type to see what is left.

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Silver for a gold medal in all 42 Shooting Range challenges, across the game's two shooting ranges. This is a skill trophy rather than a grind: learn each challenge's scoring, take your time, and redo the ones you miss — ranges stay open after the story, so there is no rush. Reported, not yet verified in-game: two ranges hold the 42 challenges between them.
steps: Visit both shooting ranges.
Earn a gold medal in each of the 42 challenges; redo any you miss.

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Bronze for winning a Top Fun drone race at all 14 locations. You only need one win per location, so learn each course's line instead of chasing fast times everywhere. Drone races stay available after the story, so this is a clean post-story cleanup trophy.
steps: Find each of the 14 Top Fun drone race locations.
Win at least one race at every location.

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Bronze for winning 20 different races. Different races count — winning the same race twenty times does not. Work through the race types as they appear (street races, Yago's strand and the rest) and keep count; the races stay open in free-roam after the story.
steps: Win 20 different races across the race types.
Do not repeat the same race — only new wins count.

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Bronze for beating Cal in a fishing challenge. Fishing challenges are one of the activity types, so this also counts toward Master of None. Challenge Cal when fishing is available and out-fish him — the trophy pops on the win, not on the catch alone. Do it early: it is a quick trophy that needs no grind.
steps: Start a fishing challenge against Cal.
Beat his catch to win the challenge.

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Bronze for completing one arcade game. Find an arcade machine in Leonida, play a full game through to its end, and the trophy pops. Any arcade game counts, so pick the easiest one you find and finish it — no high score is needed.
steps: Find an arcade machine.
Play one arcade game through to completion.

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Bronze for finishing Andy's questline — the final mission of one of the side-story character strands. Andy's strand is Lucia-only, per the launch-week guides, and it stays available after the story, so there is no rush. Follow Andy's missions to their end and the trophy pops on the finale.
steps: Play Andy's missions as Lucia until the strand ends.
Finish Andy's final mission.

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Bronze for finishing Kenton's questline — the final mission of one of the side-story character strands. The side-story finales stay open after the credits, so play Kenton's missions at your own pace and the trophy pops on the last one.
steps: Play Kenton's missions until the strand ends.
Finish Kenton's final mission.

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Bronze for finishing Billy's questline — the final mission of one of the side-story character strands. Billy's strand stays available after the story. Note that Billy's strand does not count toward Strangers & Freaks (it has its own trophy), so do not expect that counter to move here.
steps: Play Billy's missions until the strand ends.
Finish Billy's final mission.

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Silver for completing 8 stranger mission strands. Only some questlines count: Andy's, Billy's and Tyrone's do not, because they have their own trophies. Yago's street racing strand does count — and its Race Against Yago in Chapter 3 is time-sensitive, so do it the moment it appears. Check the trophy's progress counter after each strand you finish to see which ones counted.
steps: Do Race Against Yago in Chapter 3 as soon as it appears (time-sensitive).
Finish 8 stranger strands that count; check the counter after each one.
Andy's, Billy's and Tyrone's strands do not count — they have their own trophies.

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Bronze for finishing Randy's questline — the final mission of one of the side-story character strands. The side-story finales stay open after the credits, so play Randy's missions at your own pace and the trophy pops on the last one.
steps: Play Randy's missions until the strand ends.
Finish Randy's final mission.

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Bronze for finishing Tyrone's questline — the final mission of one of the side-story character strands. Tyrone's strand is Jason-only, per the launch-week guides, and it stays available after the story. Like Andy's and Billy's, it does not count toward Strangers & Freaks.
steps: Play Tyrone's missions as Jason until the strand ends.
Finish Tyrone's final mission.

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.missable_note: Potentially missable: the first meditation, Lucia on the balcony of Jason's house in Chapter 1, disappears after that chapter. It is not confirmed that the trophy strictly needs it — do it anyway.
trophies.guide: The only potentially missable trophy on the list — bronze for meditating at all 18 spots across Leonida, in 10 locations. Meditation spots show as purple icons when you are close, and each outdoor spot should count twice if you meditate there with both characters, so bring your partner every time. The danger is Chapter 1: after the mission Down to Earth, talk to Lucia in the kitchen in the morning — she says she is going to meditate, heads to the balcony of Jason's house, and you must follow her and accept. That meditation is gone once Chapter 1 ends, and there is no mission replay. Keep a Chapter 1 save until the trophy pops. Note the 100% checklist only needs 15 of the 18 spots, so this trophy is the only reason the Chapter 1 one matters.
steps: Chapter 1: after Down to Earth, talk to Lucia in the kitchen in the morning, follow her to the balcony and accept the meditation.
Keep a Chapter 1 manual save until the trophy pops.
Meditate at all 18 spots; bring your partner so each outdoor spot counts twice.

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Bronze for hunting a unique animal for Bret Vogel. Bret's hunting questline is Jason-only and sends you after animals through target decks. A clean head or heart shot keeps the carcass pristine, which is what the hunt wants. The strand stays available after the story.
steps: Play Bret's hunting questline as Jason.
Hunt the unique animal with a clean head or heart shot.

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Silver for completing 3 collectible card sets. Cards are a collectible hunt across Leonida — gather full sets rather than random singles, and track which sets you have finished. Collectibles stay available after the story, so this is post-story cleanup; no card is missable.
steps: Collect cards across Leonida.
Complete 3 full card sets.

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: Silver for using WAiNK It at 100 locations. WAiNK is the in-game app you also use to scan vehicles for Whip It Good, so the two trophies feed each other: scan traffic and locations as you drive and both counters climb together. It is a long grind, not a hard one — fold it into your travel rather than hunting locations one by one.
steps: Use WAiNK It at locations as you travel Leonida.
Scan vehicles with the same app to feed Whip It Good at the same time.

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Bronze for completing 50 Challenges. Challenges are listed under Progress > Challenges, and many complete on their own while you play. Keep going past 50: the 100% checklist needs 70 of the 80, so the trophy is a milestone on the way to A Long Road, not the finish line.
steps: Open Progress > Challenges to see what is close.
Complete 50 Challenges, then continue to 70 for A Long Road.

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: Bronze for losing a 4-star wanted level with your partner and escaping the heat. The easiest way is a bank vault robbery: vault jobs give you a 4-star wanted level straight away, and escaping one with your partner earns this at the same time as Maximum Withdrawal. The trophy only pops once you have left the red heat zone, not just the flashing search area, so keep driving until the stars are gone.
steps: Bring your partner and commit a crime that reaches 4 stars — a bank vault works.
Escape until you leave the red heat zone entirely.

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Bronze for robbing 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your wanted level. Call your partner, then rob three shops in a row while the police are still chasing you: if the stars fade and you are only in the red heat zone, the chain breaks. The trophy can take about 30 seconds to pop after you leave the third shop, so give it a moment before hitting a fourth.
steps: Call your partner, then rob a shop to start a wanted level.
Rob two more shops in a row without letting the wanted level drop.
Wait about 30 seconds after the third shop for the pop.

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Bronze for discovering 100 vehicles. Scanning a vehicle with the WAiNK app counts as discovering it, so scan traffic as you drive — it becomes a habit that also feeds You WAiNKer!. The 100% checklist needs 200 of the 277 base models, so keep scanning past 100.
steps: Scan vehicles with the WAiNK app as you drive.
Reach 100 discovered, then continue to 200 for A Long Road.

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Bronze for taking down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus — the slow-motion aim you trigger by pressing L3 and R3 while aiming. Pick a group of gang enemies, such as the guards at an illegal operation, and use an assault rifle; Adrenaline extends Focus, so use it to stretch the window. Save first, then try until it pops.
steps: Find a group of 5 or more enemies, e.g. guards at an illegal operation.
Aim, press L3 and R3 for Combat Focus, and down 5 with an assault rifle before it ends.

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Bronze for stealing a plane at Vice City International Airport. It has to be a large passenger plane docked at a boarding bridge — planes parked out on the airfield do not count, and the gates E3 and E4 are reported to work. Board, back out toward the runway and take off; the trophy is delayed, so fly about 1 km away from the airport before expecting the pop. Save first — the police come fast.
steps: At VCIA, take a large passenger plane docked at a boarding bridge (gates E3 and E4 work).
Take off and fly about 1 km away from the airport.
Save before you try — police respond fast.

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: Bronze for getting into a Rhino tank. Tanks are reported to be parked on the south side of Mile Zero Air Station, on the island at the far southwest of the map. Save first, get in, and drive and fire until it pops. The exact trigger is reported, not yet verified in-game, so if one tank does not pop it, try driving and firing more before moving on.
steps: Go to the south side of Mile Zero Air Station, far southwest of the map.
Get into a parked Rhino tank and drive and fire until it pops.

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Bronze for robbing a jewelry store without being detected. The Chapter 3 mission Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs gives you the Snap Gun and opens jewelry store robberies: go to a store's locked back door and use the Snap Gun on it — kicking the door in sets off the alarm. Inside the back room, find the note with the safe code, open the safe, and leave without being seen. Richardson Jewelry & Diamonds in Vice City is a reported good target. If someone spots you, reload rather than push on.
steps: Finish the Chapter 3 mission Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs to get the Snap Gun.
Use the Snap Gun on a jewelry store's locked back door — never kick it in.
Find the safe-code note in the back room, open the safe, leave unseen.

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: Silver for robbing 5 bank vaults and escaping. Bank vaults unlock through That's Where The Money Is, an optional mission near the end of Chapter 4: tail an armored security van to a large bank and get into the vault while the guard has it open. You cannot carry all the bags alone, so bring your partner — and since a vault job gives you a 4-star wanted level straight away, escaping one with your partner also earns Hot Together. The 100% checklist needs all 8 vaults, so keep going past 5.
steps: Do the optional mission That's Where The Money Is (late Chapter 4).
Bring your partner, tail an armored van to a bank, enter the vault while the guard has it open.
Rob 5 vaults and escape; continue to 8 for A Long Road.

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Bronze for robbing an armored truck and escaping. Armored trucks run the roads of Leonida — hit one, take its cash and get clear. Like Hot Together, this trophy only pops once you have left the red heat zone, not just the flashing search area, so keep moving until the heat is fully gone.
steps: Find and rob an armored truck.
Escape until you leave the red heat zone entirely.

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Bronze for exploring all 52 areas of Leonida. This is pure map coverage: visit every named area on the map and the trophy pops. Fold it into your other travel — drive through areas you have not visited while doing missions, races and collectibles — and check the map for the gaps at the end.
steps: Visit all 52 areas of Leonida.
Check the map for unvisited areas and drive through them.

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Bronze for robbing an illegal operation belonging to each of the 9 gangs. Illegal operations are the gang-run fronts scattered across Leonida — one robbery per gang is all the trophy needs. The 100% checklist wants all 39 operations, so the trophy pops on the way to A Long Road.
steps: Find the illegal operations across Leonida.
Rob one operation from each of the 9 gangs; continue to all 39 for A Long Road.

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Not yet confirmed at launch: no published guide has pinned down this trophy's trigger, and the official description is the only hint — a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach. The honest read is that it pops when you drink at a beachfront spot on Ocean Beach; it may well pop while you play normally. Do not grind for it until a method is confirmed — check the sources below for updates.
steps: Go to Ocean Beach and look for a beachfront bar or cocktail spot.
Have a cocktail there with the ocean view.
Method unconfirmed at launch — see Sources for updates.

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Not yet confirmed at launch: no published guide has pinned down this trophy's trigger. The description points at a vehicle showroom and a smash-out in classic GTA style — most likely driving a car through the showroom glass and out. It may pop while you play normally. Until a method is confirmed, treat the description itself as the guide and check the sources for updates.
steps: Find a vehicle showroom.
Drive a car through it and smash your way out.
Method unconfirmed at launch — see Sources for updates.

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Bronze for the Kolt & Associates bowling alley — Kingpin Bowling, an illegal operation you visit in Chapter 2. Bring Sticky Bombs. Take all three key valuables: the luxury watch in an office, the shotgun on a table, and the contents of the office safe, which you blow open with a Sticky Bomb. Then escape the police. If you leave something behind, the operation comes back later, so it is not missable.
steps: In Chapter 2, go to Kingpin Bowling with Sticky Bombs.
Take the luxury watch, the shotgun and the office safe contents.
Escape the police; if you miss a valuable, the operation returns later.

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide: Bronze for Jason and Lucia both reaching maximum Strength. Buy a gym membership and train with your partner there, since the partner trains alongside you. It should pop when both characters hit maximum Strength — a slow, steady grind you can fold into downtime between missions.
steps: Buy a gym membership.
Train with your partner until both Jason and Lucia reach maximum Strength.

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: Bronze for 500 actions that change your Criminal Profile, per the PSN progress counter. Robberies and fights feed it, so it fills up without a separate grind — just play the game the way the other trophies ask you to, and it pops on its own somewhere in the cleanup stage.
steps: Play normally: robberies, fights and criminal activity all count.
Reach 500 profile-changing actions; no separate grind needed.

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.guide: Not yet confirmed at launch: no published guide has pinned down this trophy's trigger. The description — 'Second time's the charm' — suggests succeeding at something on a second attempt, most likely retrying a failed activity or mission and passing it. It may pop while you play normally. Do not grind for it until a method is confirmed.
steps: If you fail an activity or challenge, retry it and pass on the second attempt.
Method unconfirmed at launch — see Sources for updates.

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.guide: Not yet confirmed at launch: no published guide has pinned down this trophy's trigger. The description — 'What the hell just happened?' — points at witnessing something strange, most likely a random event or easter egg somewhere in Leonida. It may pop while you play normally. Until a method is confirmed, keep an eye out for odd encounters and check the sources for updates.
steps: Explore Leonida and watch for strange random events or easter eggs.
Method unconfirmed at launch — see Sources for updates.

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Not yet confirmed at launch: no published guide has pinned down this trophy's exact trigger. The description is clear on the shape of it — knock people over with a melee drive-by, i.e. a melee attack from a moving vehicle. Try it from a slow-moving car with a melee weapon against a group on foot. It may pop while you play normally; check the sources for a confirmed method.
steps: From a moving vehicle, use a melee attack to knock people over.
Method unconfirmed at launch — see Sources for updates.

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Bronze for laundering $250,000 of Marked Bills through your contacts. Marked bills come from bank and payday loan jobs, and you launder them by selling them to your contacts. The $250,000 total is cumulative, so bank vault and payday jobs you do for other trophies feed it — do not treat it as a separate grind until the vaults are done.
steps: Earn Marked Bills from bank and payday loan jobs.
Sell them to your contacts to launder them, until $250,000 total.

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Bronze for spending $100,000 across all shops. The total is cumulative across every kind of shop, so it fills up from normal play — clothes, weapons, food and the rest. It pairs naturally with Little Boxes: the eight garages cost about $160,000 together, which alone clears this trophy.
steps: Spend across any shops; the $100,000 total is cumulative.
Buying the eight garages for Little Boxes (~$160,000) clears it on its own.

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Bronze for buying all 8 garage properties. Buy them in the Vice City Real Estate app, which unlocks after the Chapter 2 mission Daily Driver. Together they cost about $160,000 — which also clears Treat Yo Self. Garages the story gives you do not count, and each car you register for On the Spot needs a free garage space, so buy garages before registering cars.
steps: After the Chapter 2 mission Daily Driver, open the Vice City Real Estate app.
Buy all 8 garage properties (~$160,000 total).

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Bronze for registering 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. The Chapter 2 mission Moses opens the app: take a stolen car to Moses, choose Respray, then Register. From Chapter 3 you can also register cars with a standard tracker at Pay 'n' Spray. Each car needs a free garage space, so buy the garages for Little Boxes first, then register cheap cars.
steps: Finish the Chapter 2 mission Moses to open the Scooter Bros app.
Take a stolen car to Moses, Respray, then Register — repeat for 10 vehicles.
Buy garages first: each registered car needs a free garage space.
